verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments platform with a dashboard, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask, but the pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data. The MCP server only answers questions about the Finix API from documentation, and the automated reports are not AI-generated. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
